title: 医疗可及性
summary: 评估医疗健康公司提升医疗服务可及性（价格、渠道、创新）的机遇。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Access to Health Care Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate's (MSCI S&C's) $^{1}$ outputs are determined. Access to Health Care is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their positioning to meet market demand for health care products and services in developing countries and underserved markets.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍医疗可及性关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解 MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队（MSCI S&C）$^{1}$ 如何形成评估结果。医疗可及性属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估考察其满足发展中国家及服务不足市场医疗产品与服务需求的布局与能力。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“数据、评级与得分”章节。

sections.title_en: Opportunities associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的机遇

blocks.content: \- Opportunities for revenue and profit growth in the medium to long term from increased penetration of underserved populations.
blocks.content_cn: • 通过提高对服务不足人群的覆盖率，获得中长期收入及利润增长机会。

blocks.content: \- Protect license to operate and current business model from regulatory and public pressure on pricing and access.
blocks.content_cn: • 应对定价与可及性方面的监管及公众压力，保护运营许可和现有商业模式。

sections.title_en: Access to Health Care Key Issue score
sections.title_cn: 医疗可及性关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Access to Health Care Key Issue score evaluates the company's level of exposure to, and management opportunities on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that the Exposure score determines the weight placed on the Management score, ranging from 50% (when Exposure score is equal to zero) to 100% (when Exposure score is equal to 10).
blocks.content_cn: 医疗可及性关键议题得分评估公司在此议题上的机遇敞口及机遇管理水平。该得分根据敞口得分与管理得分，按下列公式计算。二者的结合方式为：敞口得分决定管理得分的权重，范围从 50%（敞口得分为零）至 100%（敞口得分为 10）。

blocks.content:
$$
K I _ {i} = \left(\left(\frac {E X P _ {i}}{2 0} + 0. 5\right) \times M G M T _ {i}\right) + \left(\left(0. 5 - \frac {E X P _ {i}}{2 0}\right) \times 5\right)
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $KI_{i}$ is the Key Issue score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $KI_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的关键议题得分。

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{i}$ is the Exposure score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $MGMT_{i}$ is the Management score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $MGMT_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的管理得分。

MSCI S&C assigns each indicator a default weight. MSCI S&C may adjust weights at the company level to reflect the relevance of the indicator to the company's business activities. If a company has no exposure to the business activities covered by an indicator, the indicator is assigned a weight of zero.

sections.title_en: Access to Health Care Management score
sections.title_cn: 医疗可及性管理得分

blocks.content: The Access to Health Care Management score evaluates the company's ability to manage its exposure to opportunities on this Key Issue. It is based on weighted average of the score associated with each relevant indicator, modified by controversies.
blocks.content_cn: 医疗可及性管理得分评估公司管理此关键议题机遇敞口的能力，以各相关指标得分的加权平均值为基础，并通过争议调整。

blocks.content: This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice and 0 corresponding to lack of management. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of "ESG Ratings Methodology" for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.
blocks.content_cn: 该得分来源于按0—10分评分的指标，10分代表最佳实践，0分代表缺乏管理。更多详情请参阅《ESG评级方法论》的“风险管理分析”部分。除另有说明外，数据来源为公司披露。

sections.title_en: Access to Health Care Practices score
sections.title_cn: 医疗可及性实践得分

blocks.content: The Access to Health Care Practices score evaluates the company's ability to manage its exposure to opportunities related to its positioning to meet market demand for health care products and services in developing countries and underserved markets. This score is equal to the Access to Health Care Management score (excluding controversies) and considers attributes of the company's policies and initiatives. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 医疗可及性实践得分评估公司管理相关机遇敞口的能力，即满足发展中国家及服务不足市场医疗产品与服务需求的布局与能力。该得分等于医疗可及性管理得分（不含争议调整），考察公司政策及举措的特征，采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

blocks.content: Note: Diseases within the scope of this key issue are (1) diseases with the highest global burden as measured by disability adjusted life years, (2) orphan diseases and (3) neglected tropical diseases.
blocks.content_cn: 注：本关键议题涵盖的疾病包括：（1）按伤残调整寿命年衡量的全球负担最高疾病；（2）罕见病；（3）被忽视的热带病。

sections.title_en: - Number of relevant diseases addressed by the company's commercialized products
sections.title_cn: 公司已商业化产品覆盖的相关疾病数量

blocks.content: Definition: The number of diseases within the scope of this key issue for which the company has commercialized products on the market.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：本关键议题范围内，公司已在市场上提供商业化产品的疾病数量。

sections.title_en: - Number of relevant diseases addressed by the company's research and development
sections.title_cn: 公司研发覆盖的相关疾病数量

blocks.content: Definition: The number of diseases within the scope of this key issue for which the company has ongoing research and development.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：本关键议题范围内，公司正在开展研发的疾病数量。

sections.title_en: - Scope of expansion plans to low-income and middle-income countries
sections.title_cn: 向低收入及中等收入国家扩张计划的覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company explicitly states it plans to expand operations and markets to low-income and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. Applies to pharmaceutical, biotech and medical devices operations and markets.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否明确计划将运营及市场扩展至世界银行定义的低收入及中等收入国家。适用于制药、生物技术及医疗器械运营和市场。

sections.title_en: - Assistance to local manufacturers to achieve international drug manufacturing quality standards in low- and middle-income countries
sections.title_cn: 帮助低收入及中等收入国家本地制造商达到国际药品制造质量标准

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to improve the capacity of local manufacturers in low- and middle-income countries (as defined by the World Bank) to manufacture products to international quality standards such as the World Health Organization's Good Manufacturing Practices. These initiatives aim to address local needs, in partnership with local stakeholders, and may have long-term sustainability aims.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否采取举措，提升世界银行定义的低收入及中等收入国家本地制造商按国际质量标准生产产品的能力，例如世界卫生组织药品生产质量管理规范。这些举措与当地利益相关方合作，旨在满足当地需求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。

sections.title_en: • Supports pharmacovigilance in low- and middle-income countries
sections.title_cn: • 支持低收入及中等收入国家的药物警戒

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company supports initiatives to build capacity to improve pharmacovigilance capability (i.e., monitoring the effects of drugs and vaccines after sale to detect and assess adverse effects or any other medicine- or vaccine-related problem) in low- and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives are typically carried out with local relevant partners and aligned with local needs, and their goals and outcomes are generally measured.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否支持能力建设举措，提升世界银行定义的低收入及中等收入国家的药物警戒能力，即监测药品及疫苗上市后的效果，发现和评估不良反应或其他药品、疫苗相关问题。此类举措通常与当地相关伙伴合作并符合当地需求，一般会衡量目标与成果。

sections.title_en: - Trains local healthcare workers in low- and middle-income countries
sections.title_cn: 培训低收入及中等收入国家的当地医护人员

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to train health care workers in low- and middle-income countries (as defined by the World Bank) to strengthen the existing health system and build local capacity. These initiatives aim to address local needs in partnership with local stakeholders and may have long-term sustainability aims.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否在世界银行定义的低收入及中等收入国家培训医护人员，以强化现有卫生体系并建设当地能力。这些举措与当地利益相关方合作，旨在满足当地需求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。

sections.title_en: - Improves availability of products to patients through pharmaceutical supply chain initiatives in low- and middle-income countries
sections.title_cn: 通过低收入及中等收入国家的药品供应链举措改善患者产品可获得性

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to improve the pharmaceutical supply chain, beyond its own supply chain, in low- and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives aim to address local needs in partnership with local stakeholders and may have long-term sustainability aims. Examples include initiatives to improve the last-mile supply of essential medicines.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否在世界银行定义的低收入及中等收入国家，开展超出自身供应链范围的药品供应链改善举措。这些举措与当地利益相关方合作，旨在满足当地需求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标，例如改善基本药物最后一公里供应。

sections.title_en: - Involvement in public-private partnerships for improving local research and development capacity in low- and middle-income countries
sections.title_cn: 参与提升低收入及中等收入国家本地研发能力的公私合作

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company undertakes public-private partnerships to strengthen local research and development capability in low- and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives aim to address local needs and skill requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders, and may have long-term sustainability aims.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否通过公私合作，强化世界银行定义的低收入及中等收入国家的本地研发能力。这些举措与相关利益方合作，旨在满足当地需求及技能要求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。

sections.title_en: - Capacity building of public health infrastructure, information, or health programs in low- and middle-income countries
sections.title_cn: 建设低收入及中等收入国家公共卫生基础设施、信息或健康计划能力

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to improve public health systems in terms of infrastructure, information, or health programs in low- and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives aim to address local needs and skill requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and may have long-term sustainability aims.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否在世界银行定义的低收入及中等收入国家，从基础设施、信息或健康计划方面改善公共卫生体系。这些举措与相关利益方合作，旨在满足当地需求及技能要求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。

sections.title_en: • Number of non-exclusive voluntary licenses issued or received
sections.title_cn: • 发出或取得的非独占自愿许可数量

blocks.content: Definition: The number of non-exclusive voluntary licenses (NEVLs) that a patent holder has issued or that a generic manufacturer has received to allow the manufacture and supply of generic versions of patented medicines by other manufacturers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：专利持有人发出、或仿制药制造商取得的非独占自愿许可数量，用于允许其他制造商生产和供应专利药的仿制版本。

sections.title_en: • Extent of pricing policies based on affordability
sections.title_cn: • 基于可负担性的定价政策程度

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company implements tiered pricing (i.e., tailoring the price according to local ability to pay) for its products between countries, within countries or on both levels. Applies to patented drugs, generics, vaccines and medical devices.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否在国家之间、同一国家内部或两个层面实施分层定价，即根据当地支付能力调整价格。适用于专利药、仿制药、疫苗及医疗器械。

blocks.content: \- Signed licensing agreements or entered into manufacturing contracts with the Medicines Patent Pool (MPP)
blocks.content_cn: • 与药品专利池签署许可协议或制造合同

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company's licensing agreements or manufacturing contracts with the Medicines Patent Pool (MPP).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司与药品专利池签署许可协议或制造合同的程度。

sections.title_en: - Pricing transparency in developed and developing markets
sections.title_cn: 发达及发展中市场的定价透明度

blocks.content: Definition: Describes the level of detail provided by a company regarding its product pricing. Applies to healthcare companies only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明公司提供产品定价信息的详细程度。仅适用于医疗保健公司。

sections.title_en: - Is the company conducting R&D to address antibiotic resistance (e.g., in-house R&D, partnerships)?
sections.title_cn: 公司是否开展应对抗生素耐药性的研发，例如内部研发或合作？

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company engages in antibiotic stewardship initiatives, such as collaboration on research and development of solutions for antibiotic resistance, or partnerships with industry peers, academia, or other entities to address antibiotic resistance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否参与抗生素合理使用管理举措，例如合作研发抗生素耐药性解决方案，或与行业同业、学术界及其他主体合作应对耐药性。

blocks.content: Sources: Company disclosures, MPP.
blocks.content_cn: 来源：公司披露；药品专利池。

sections.title_en: Controversies
sections.title_cn: 争议事件

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management score based on the severity, status, and the company's role in the controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment:
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在此关键议题上所涉争议的严重程度、状态及公司角色，从总体管理得分中扣减 0—5 分。评估采用以下争议类别。

blocks.content: \- Restricted or discriminatory access controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 获取受到限制或歧视的争议。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to the Controversies cases section of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 关于争议如何纳入 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“争议案例”章节。

sections.title_en: Access to Health Care Exposure score
sections.title_cn: 医疗可及性风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Access to Health Exposure score evaluates the company's exposure to opportunities on this Key Issue. It is based on the average of the Business Segment Exposure score and the Company-Specific Exposure score, combined with the Geographic Exposure score. The Geographic Exposure score functions as a multiplier on the averaged Business and Company-Specific Exposure scores, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business Exposure score, Geographic Exposure score and Company-Specific Exposure score are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to the Analyzing risk exposure section of "ESG Ratings Methodology" for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 医疗可及性敞口得分评估公司在此关键议题上的机遇敞口，以业务分部与公司特定敞口得分的平均值为基础，并结合地域敞口得分。地域敞口得分作为该平均值的乘数，影响范围为 -50% 至 +50%。业务、地域及公司特定敞口得分采用 0—10 分制；原文将 10 分解释为最高风险、0 分解释为最低风险。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“风险敞口分析”章节。计算公式如下：（本段“机遇”与“风险”用词不一致，待校核。）

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ {A H E, i} = \left(\frac {B U S _ {A H E , i} + C O M _ {A H E , i}}{2}\right) (1 + 0. 1 \bigl (G E O _ {A H E, i} - 5 \bigr))
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{AHE,i}$ is the Access to Health Care Exposure score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{AHE,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的医疗可及性敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $BUS_{AHE,i}$ is the Business Exposure score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BUS_{AHE,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的业务敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $COM_{AHE,i}$ is the Company-Specific Exposure score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $COM_{AHE,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的公司特定敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $GEO_{AHE,i}$ is the Geographic Exposure score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $GEO_{AHE,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的地域敞口得分。

sections.title_en: Business Segment Exposure score
sections.title_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. MSCI S&C uses the score associated with a business activity to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. MSCI S&C determines each business activity score by a qualitative assessment of business segments linked to health care services such as pharmaceutical preparations.
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动，再用业务活动得分计算业务分部敞口得分。各业务活动得分通过定性评估与医疗服务相关的业务分部确定，例如药品制剂。

sections.title_en: Geographic Segment Exposure scores
sections.title_cn: 地理分区敞口得分

blocks.content: The Geographic Segment Exposure score is determined by a simple average of the Physician Concentration score and the Out-Of-pocket Health score:
blocks.content_cn: 地域分部敞口得分为医生密度得分与自付医疗支出得分的简单平均值：

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $PC_{c}$ is the Physician Concentration score in country or market $c$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $PC_{c}$ 为国家或市场 $c$ 的医生密度得分。

blocks.content: \- $OOPH_{c}$ is the Out-Of-Pocket Health score in country or market $c$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $OOPH_{c}$ 为国家或市场 $c$ 的自付医疗支出得分。

blocks.content: The Physician Concentration score is derived from the number of physicians per 1,000 people in each country, whereby a lower ratio indicates a higher opportunity score. The Out-Of-Pocket Health score is derived from the out-of-pocket expenditure as a percentage of total health care expenditure (normalized by gross national income per capita), whereby a lower percentage indicates a higher opportunity score.
blocks.content_cn: 医生密度得分根据各国每 1,000 人拥有的医生数量确定，比例越低，机遇得分越高。自付医疗支出得分根据自付支出占医疗总支出的比例确定，并按人均国民总收入标准化；原文规定比例越低，机遇得分越高。
